summary: PDPV Bot Interno unification with /intake module — 15/15 new backend tests + 24/24 existing intake regression tests all PASS. Internal Telegram webhook correctly creates documents in intake_requests (NOT pre_tickets) for authorized users, blocks unauthorized ones, and properly stores ai_extracted, source_bot=PDPV_INTERNAL_BOT, reference PT*, created_by_name, telegram_user_id. Old webhooks (/api/telegram/webhook, /api/renting/webhook, /api/telegram-alerts/webhook) still respond 200. /intake UI shows 53 records with Bot Interno (indigo) and Bot Antigo (azul) badges. Convert dialog correctly pre-fills cliente/telefone/matrícula and description (with 'Resumo IA' line) from ai_extracted. /admin/telegram-users admin page renders the seeded user 999000111 'Test Operator' with bot info and Telegram Users sidebar entry visible.

issues: WebSocket /ws/<jwt> connection fails repeatedly in browser console (warning + error). Not blocking but spammy; backend may not support WS or wrong URL/protocol.

action_items: Optional: investigate the WebSocket /ws/<jwt> 'closed before connection established' console errors observed throughout the dashboard.

Optional: verify whether the Edit dialog (pencil icon) exposes the IntakeAIDetails indigo panel — testing surfaced the Notes review dialog when clicking the first row action; manual visual check recommended (the AI data is correctly persisted and surfaces in the Convert dialog and row cells).
critical_code_review_comments: Internal-bot pre_ticket flow correctly writes to intake_requests via the intake service (no parallel pre_tickets writes observed; pre_tickets stats endpoint returns 0).
Webhook secret validation is enforced (wrong secret returns 401).
Unauthorized telegram user receives {status: ok} but DOES NOT create any intake document — confirmed before/after counts unchanged.
/api/intake/{id}/attachments/{att_id} proxy correctly requires JWT (401/403 without auth).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on verified flows (intake list with badges, convert pre-fill, admin telegram users, sidebar entry)

seed_data_creation: Tests created temporary intakes (cleaned up) and one authorized-bot pre-ticket flow that produced a real intake_requests document with reference starting with PT*. No mock data introduced.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 21 unified PDPV Bot Interno pre-tickets into the existing /intake module. Webhook URL: POST /api/telegram/internal/webhook with header X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token=pdpv_internal_webhook_2026. Authorized seeded user: telegram_user_id=999000111 (Test Operator). To verify a new bot flow end-to-end, send /start → callback menu:pre_ticket → text message → callback preticket:finalize, then GET /api/intake?source=telegram and look for source_bot=PDPV_INTERNAL_BOT items. Run regression: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_21_pdpv_internal.py /app/backend/tests/test_intake_module.py. Renting webhook lives at /api/renting/webhook (NOT /api/renting/telegram/webhook).
